title: Edge-Case Sweep
prompt: Implement clamp(value, low, high) returning value bounded into [low, high]. Write TestClamp with subTest sweeping: below range, above range, at each boundary, and equal low==high. Assign to SUITE_TEST.

tests.name: clamps correctly
tests.code:
assert clamp(-5, 0, 10) == 0
assert clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10
assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
assert clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0
assert clamp(7, 7, 7) == 7
tests.hint: Boundaries are inclusive on both ends.

tests.name: boundary sweep present
tests.code:
import unittest, io
assert 'subTest' in code, 'use self.subTest in the suite'
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO(), verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(SUITE_TEST))
assert result.wasSuccessful(), 'clamp tests failed'
tests.hint: One parametrized test covering all five behaviors.
